scripts.dev: npm run build -w @agent-evals/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agent-evals/api" "npm run dev -w @agent-evals/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-evals/shared && npm run build -w @agent-evals/api && npm run build -w @agent-evals/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @agent-evals/shared && npm run test -w @agent-evals/api && npm run test -w @agent-evals/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agent-evals/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agent-evals/api && npm run typecheck -w @agent-evals/web
